newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Fila EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Fila EPS view cut.

text.p: Gruntal & Co said it cut its earnings estimate for Fila Holding SpA to $0.53 per ADS share from $0.92 per ADS.
-- said cut the full year 1997 estimate to $3.35 per ADS from $4.30 per ADS.
-- cut the fiscal 1998 estimate to $3.70 per ADS from $4.95 per ADS.

-- on Friday, Fila said it expects earnings for the second quarter to fall below analysts' expectations. The company cited weakness in the U.S. footwear and apparel market and unexpected problems with its warehouse software system, which affected deliveries.
